origin.description: Splices value between start and stop so the result reads as the original edited in place.
origin.usage: `substr_ctl<-`(x, start, stop, value, warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), term.cap = getOption("fansi.term.cap", dflt_term_cap()), ctl = "all", normalize = getOption("fansi.normalize", FALSE), carry = getOption("fansi.carry", FALSE), terminate = getOption("fansi.terminate", TRUE))
origin.details: Splices value between start and stop so the result reads as the original edited in place.
origin.value: A character vector, or a list of character vectors for strsplit.

translation.description: Splices value between start and stop so the result reads as the original edited in place.
translation.usage: substr_ctl_replace(x, start, stop, value, warn=None, term_cap=None, ctl="all", normalize=None, carry=None, terminate=None)
translation.details: Splices value between start and stop so the result reads as the original edited in place. A string is one element. None is a missing string. The replacement functions are substr_ctl_replace and substr2_ctl_replace.
translation.value: A list of strings, or a list of lists for strsplit.
